upsertPapers.title: Deterministic Streaming Lower Bounds for Approximate Maximum Clique and Maximum Independent Set

upsertSlices.label: Maximum independent set: space for approximation
upsertSlices.task: One pass · deterministic · insertions and deletions · explicit independent set
assumptions: Both bounds have leading exponent s=2−t. Green and red are separated by a few screen pixels only for visibility; that offset does not encode a numerical gap. Logarithmic factors and exact finite-n ranges are retained below. Open endpoints mean fixed t<1 (algorithm) and fixed t<1/2 (lower bound), not inclusion of β=n or β=√n.

results.sourceLocation: Theorem A.1 (folklore algorithm presented in Appendix A)
results.notes: General simple unweighted graphs; vertex set known in advance; Explicit independent vertex set I; Deterministic; 1 ≤ β ≤ n/log₂ n; Partition the vertices into balanced groups, store each induced adjacency matrix, and return the largest exact independent set among the groups. Computation may be exponential. This is a folklore algorithm, not a new algorithm claim.

General simple unweighted graphs; vertex set known in advance; Explicit independent vertex set I; Deterministic; 1 ≤ β ≤ √n/(36 log₂ n); The complement construction uses deletions. Version 2 narrows the earlier version's approximation range following corrections. The preprint statement and model were checked; its proof was not independently certified.
